does: Colibrì is a pure-C inference engine that runs frontier MoE models (744B to 2.8T parameters) on consumer and heterogeneous hardware by treating storage, RAM, and VRAM as one memory hierarchy. It uniquely provides a web dashboard with live expert routing visualization and a measured expert atlas, enabling unprecedented transparency into model internals.
why_use: Unlike API-based services, Colibrì lets you hold the model: probe it, measure it, and modify the code. It runs on hardware you already own, with no SLA on speed but a hard guarantee on semantics—no silent precision changes. The live visualization of expert routing and the measured atlas are features no other engine offers.
gap: Runs frontier MoE models on consumer hardware but requires deep technical setup and lacks a polished product for non-technical users.
counter: The big cloud AI providers (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic) already offer frontier models via API with better speed and reliability; a solo builder can't compete on scale or support. Also, the project is research-focused, so it may remain a niche tool for enthusiasts, not a viable business.
differentiator: Package Colibrì as a one-click desktop app for Mac/Windows that lets non-technical users run a frontier model locally, with a simplified UI and automatic hardware detection.
hook: AI developers and researchers who can't afford datacenter GPUs but need frontier-scale model inference on the hardware they already own.

zh.claim: 在消费级PC上以可用速度运行744B参数的MoE模型，纯C实现，零引擎依赖。
zh.hook: 无法负担数据中心GPU但需要在现有硬件上运行前沿规模模型推理的AI开发者和研究人员。
zh.does: Colibrì是一个纯C推理引擎，通过将存储、RAM和VRAM视为一个内存层次结构，在消费级和异构硬件上运行前沿MoE模型（744B至2.8T参数）。它独特地提供了带有实时专家路由可视化和测量专家图谱的Web仪表板，实现了对模型内部前所未有的透明度。
zh.why_use: 与基于API的服务不同，Colibrì让你拥有模型：可以探测、测量和修改代码。它在你已有的硬件上运行，不保证速度但保证语义——不静默改变精度。实时可视化和测量图谱是其他引擎没有的功能。
zh.gap: 只有极客才能使用：它是一个CLI/自托管工具，没有产品化，且中国/本地市场案例为空——没有打包的消费级应用或托管服务。
zh.counter: 大型云AI提供商（OpenAI、Google、Anthropic）已经通过API提供前沿模型，速度更快、可靠性更高；独立开发者无法在规模和支持上竞争。此外，该项目以研究为导向，可能仍是爱好者的利基工具，而非可行的业务。
zh.differentiator: 将Colibrì打包为Mac/Windows的一键式桌面应用，让非技术用户也能在本地运行前沿模型，提供简化UI和自动硬件检测。
zh.value: AI研究人员和爱好者为在现有硬件上运行的本地、私有、透明的推理引擎付费，避免云成本和数据隐私问题。
zh.risk: 项目可能无法获得吸引力，因为目标用户是技术人员，他们可以使用CLI；构建消费产品可能稀释研究重点，且难以吸引付费用户。
zh.why_good: Colibrì是一个纯C推理引擎，通过将存储、RAM和VRAM视为一个内存层次结构，在消费级和异构硬件上运行前沿MoE模型（744B至2.8T参数）。它独特地提供了带有实时专家路由可视化和测量专家图谱的Web仪表板，实现了对模型内部前所未有的透明度。

consumer_angle: Enables individuals to run and inspect large AI models locally, but the opportunity is to package this into a simple, one-click tool for enthusiasts and researchers.
pick_reason: Verified pain from users struggling with setup, but the gap is not yet a clear product opportunity for a solo founder.
